name: Nickel PPS dose trial
question: Does pentosan polysulfate sodium at 100 mg once or three times daily improve IC/BPS symptoms more than placebo?

arms.label: Pentosan polysulfate sodium 100 mg once daily
pentosan polysulfate sodium 100 mg three times daily

design.population: 368 adults with IC/BPS symptoms, ICSI total score at least 8, and a positive score on each of its four items, without cystoscopic eligibility criteria.
design.locator: PubMed abstract, Materials and Methods; ClinicalTrials.gov NCT00086684, Study Design (phase)

verdictNote: Neither active dose improved the primary symptom responder endpoint over placebo.
takeaway: In adults with IC/BPS symptoms, pentosan polysulfate sodium 100 mg once or three times daily did not show superior 24-week ICSI responder rates versus placebo; the trial stopped early after an interim futility analysis.

reports.label: Primary report
reports.citation: Nickel JC, Herschorn S, Whitmore KE, et al. "Pentosan polysulfate sodium for treatment of interstitial cystitis/bladder pain syndrome: insights from a randomized, double-blind, placebo controlled study." *J Urol.* 2015;193(3):857-862. doi:10.1016/j.juro.2014.09.036

results.measure: At least 30% reduction from baseline ICSI total score at study end
results.note: No statistically significant difference between either PPS group and placebo or between the PPS groups; effect estimates and P values are not in the abstract.

harms.label: Discontinuation because of an adverse event
harms.note: The abstract gives a range, without group-specific rates or event counts.

delivery.label: Oral treatment schedule
delivery.value: Pentosan polysulfate sodium 100 mg once daily or 100 mg three times daily, or matching placebo, for 24 weeks

delivery.label: Interim analysis and closure
delivery.value: Unblinded interim analysis at 6 years, with 54% of the target 645 patients enrolled, led to early termination

relations.note: Earlier placebo-controlled PPS studies reported symptom improvement; this later dose trial found no ICSI responder advantage.
